_about: The semantic layer. Every number any surface shows is named here once. lens: cash, economic or position. laws: what must pass for the number to be trusted. stability: stable means locked by the eval to the cent; experimental means real but unfinished and labelled so wherever it appears.

cash.income.doc: Money that arrived in cash accounts, by category, excluding own transfers. A super income stream counts here under SUPER-PENSION even though it moves no net worth, because it is what a retiree lives on.

cash.spending.doc: Money that left, by category. A mortgage repayment counts at its cash amount; a card purchase counts when charged, the card repayment does not.

budget.variance.doc: Spending against the budget valid that month.

economic.income.doc: Income as the household's wealth sees it: gross salary, employer super, gross rent, dividends. Recognised on the date the evidence gives, which is not strict accrual; no household books wages by the day.

economic.expense.doc: Expenses as incurred: interest but not principal.

income.receipts.doc: Gross receipts before any cost, from payslips and activities.

income.surcharge.doc: Income for surcharge purposes: taxable income plus fringe benefits, salary sacrifice and net investment losses.

income.composition.doc: The same year by activity, so a business year or a parental-leave year is not one low bar. Lodged-first: a lodged year reads tax_line leaves by section; an open year reads derived items by activity; the grade says which.

position.balance.doc: Each account's balance, summed from postings.

position.net_worth.doc: Assets less liabilities, excluding clearing and tax position.

position.net_worth_by_owner.doc: The same, split by dated beneficial ownership, conserving cents.

loan.rate_on.doc: The rate valid on a date, as known at a date.

loan.expected_interest.doc: Computed daily, net of offset. A control, never a ledger figure.

activity.net_income.doc: Income less costs, as earned, per income-producing activity: a rental, and later an ABN.

property.cost_base.doc: Purchase price, duty, legal, capital improvements.

super.contributions.doc: By type, as the fund received them.

super.cap_used.doc: Concessional and non-concessional use against the cap for that year.

shares.realised_gain.doc: Net capital gain, after losses and the discount.

tax.item.doc: The derived draft of each return label.

tax.estimate.doc: Tax, levies, offsets and credits by the law of that year. A draft, never advice.

tax.readiness.doc: How much of the year's expected evidence is held, and what is left.

things.refresh_due.doc: Replacement costs falling due, from asset terms.

bills.committed.doc: Contracted outgoings at the price valid that month.

forecast.cash.doc: Contracts and rates rolled forward. Stored with its as_of so it can be scored later.

forecast.tax.doc: This year's tax at the current run rate. No rows yet.

advice.tax_return.doc: A model reads the draft and asks what is missing. Needs the Australian Tax MCP wired in. No rows yet.
